target.title: fix(gateway-protocol): trim connect error detail codes in readConnectErrorDetailCode
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Gateway connect-error payloads can carry padded `details.code` strings (leading/trailing whitespace). `readConnectErrorDetailCode()` previously returned the raw string after only checking `code.trim().length > 0`, so strict comparisons against `ConnectErrorDetailCodes.*` failed and downstream helpers (`readPairingConnectErrorDetails`, `formatConnectErrorMessage`) fell back to generic messages.

## Why This Change Was Made

Return `code.trim()` from `readConnectErrorDetailCode()` so normalized detail codes match canonical constants and structured formatting paths run for untrusted gateway error details.

## User Impact

Control UI and other gateway clients show correct pairing-required and protocol-mismatch messages when the server sends padded detail codes, instead of generic fallback text.

## Evidence

- Unit regressions in `packages/gateway-protocol/src/connect-error-details.test.ts`
- Direct oxlint on touched gateway-protocol files
- Standalone runtime proof against PR head `720115e02091e375b8b84be96842878dbe685458` showing padded detail codes normalize before pairing/protocol formatting

## Real behavior proof

### Standalone runtime proof

This runs outside Vitest and imports the PR-head gateway-protocol runtime module directly.

Command:

```
node --import tsx %TEMP%\openclaw-pr99555-proof.mjs
```

Output:

```json
{
  "proof": "gateway connect-error detail code trim",
  "prHead": "720115e02091e375b8b84be96842878dbe685458",
  "pairing": {
    "rawCode": "  PAIRING_REQUIRED  ",
    "normalizedCode": "PAIRING_REQUIRED",
    "details": {
      "code": "PAIRING_REQUIRED",
      "reason": "role-upgrade",
      "requestId": "req_123",
      "remediationHint": "Review the requested role upgrade, then approve the pending request."
    },
    "formattedMessage": "role upgrade pending approval (requestId: req_123)"
  },
  "protocolMismatch": {
    "rawCode": "  PROTOCOL_MISMATCH  ",
    "normalizedCode": "PROTOCOL_MISMATCH",
    "formattedMessage": "protocol mismatch: Control UI v2-v4, Gateway v3, probe min v2"
  }
}
```

### Rebase

```
git fetch origin
git rebase origin/main
# Successfully rebased (1/1); HEAD 2639cc666d4f9babd984f795d2317084da12fca1
```

### Vitest

```

```

Output:

```

Test Files  1 passed (1)
     Tests  17 passed (17)
  Duration  1.51s

[test] passed 1 Vitest shard in 16.68s
```

### Oxlint

```

```

Output: no diagnostics; exit code 0.
